I recently purchased the War Within expansion Epic Edition. The purchased has completed and the payment has been processed. Yet I’m unable to log into the live game. I can login and play the WoW1 trial edition and the PTR 11.2 just fine so there are no network issues or corrupt files for that matter and my system is working as expected and nothing it blocking me from logging into the game across the board. It’s just my live account which I have not played for 2 - 3 years, which i bought hte new expansion on, is the one that I’m unable to to log in to the game with.

I’ve opened a support ticket regarding this matter and the 2 responses I have recieved are just copy pasted boilerplate responses from the support articles. The reason why anyone would reach out via a support ticket is because the boilerplate standard messages that are on the website aren’t solving their problem. instead of responding to the ticket like a human who can read, understand, assess and troubleshoot the actual issue promptly, the support team seems to just copy and paste boilerplate text just so that they can tick off a ticket and meet their daily quota rather than being helpful. This is ridiculous and frankly unacceptable from a game that charges for the time that we get to play the game.

I’m still not able to log in and I still don’t even have a sense of confirmation that the support personnel are even bothered to even read what i have written in the support ticket let alone resolving my issue. This is not acceptable behaviour from a company like Blizzard.

I need my issuee fixed asap or my moeny back if you all are incompetent. I’ve played wow for almost 20 years and spend hours and hours playing WoW in my younger days so I keep coming back to WoW to enjoy the nostalgia. But if you can’t make it as easy and painless for a returning player to come back to WoW, then to hell with nostalgia. I have better things to spend my time and money on.

PS:

Happy to report that upon so many complaints, I finally got connected to a competent GM.

Below is the reponse. i will report back if this fixes the issue.

I’ve personally refreshed both your World of Warcraft and Battle.net account entitlements to ensure the game time and expansion are recognized as intended.

Here’s what I’d hmbly ask you to do next:

  • Completely exit both the World of Warcraft client and the Battle.net app.

  • Restart your PC or console (whichever you’re using to play).

  • Re-launch the Battle.net app and attempt to log in again.

If the issue persists even after these steps, it’s possible that the session data needs a further nudge. In that case, I recommend resetting your Battle.net password here: https://account.battle.net/recovery/

This can help reauthorize your session from a fresh state.

Know that your time is valued—every minute of game time counts, and it’s my mission to ensure none of it slips away due to technical shadows. You’re absolutely right to expect timely and intelligent assistance, and I’m here to deliver exactly that.

Solution: Connect via a VPN. Works like a charm! honestly, This should have been a simple easy suggestion by the CS person given how common this issue seems to be.

posts.name: Mirasol
posts.cooked:
LKPickAChu:

Goes through all the way upto ‘Logging in to game server’ then gives an error that says ‘You have been disconnected.

Ok, THIS IS not an issue with your purchase or account. That is usually an issue with your connection to the game, or the “state” of the character.

LKPickAChu:

I can login and play the WoW1 trial edition and the PTR 11.2 just fine so there are no network issues or corrupt files for that matter and my system is working as expected and nothing it blocking me from logging into the game across the board.

This does not actually indicate there are no connection issues. The servers for those, and the files for the PTR, are not the same as the game servers - they can be geographically very different places. Your connection does have to route through a very long chain of physical servers to get anywhere.

Really though, this sounds more like your character you are trying to log into is “stuck”, or that you have addons that are causing it to crash on load.

  1. Just to rule out any addons or UI files - esp when there was just a major patch that impacted those. Do a full UI reset, not just disabling addons. Use the option to rename or move the files so you can put them back if the rest does not help. https://us.support.blizzard.com/en/article/7549
  2. If that does not help, the character may be “stuck”. Try the self help STUCK tool, if that does not work your char may need to be manually moved.
  3. Another option, as odd as it seems, is trying a VPN if you are not using one, or trying a different internet connection or even device. That changes your routing and security measures and can sometimes help.

posts.name: Mirasol
posts.cooked:
LKPickAChu:

Any idea about how to find the game servers for a ping? Back in the days i remeber there were some routing server IPs that we could ping to check the connection.

Sadly no. When they stopped doing Tech Support and laid off those folks, they removed the IP addresses and related support articles. A WinMTR is honestly the best tool because it shows both latency and packet loss for each hop in a physical route to a server. Without an IP address though you can’t really use it.

Try the connection troubleshooting steps - and then try the Character Stuck Self help option.

Also you really want to do this with a fresh set of Cache, Interface, and WTF folders like the UI reset article says. It honestly is a troubleshooting step that is super basic, but rules a lot of things out. Again, you can just rename them or move them. The game creates fresh ones when you start up if it does not “see” the old ones there.

Wipe it anyway, even the Blizzard files that are default can get corrupted.

IF that fails a Blue here may be able to move your char for you and see if that helps.

YAY!!!

Ok, that means something along the path between you and the Live Retail server realm is having issues. Using a VPN takes your data around that point on a different ISP backbone. I don’t have any idea what might be going on to cause that, but it is like a traffic jam.

Glad that worked. Just don’t jump around from VPN to VPN like crazy or the game may think your account is compromised and lock it. Speed of light travel is not a thing yet. Stick one one VPN and always use that one when you do and it should see a consistent pattern.

Enjoy War Within! It does have some really fun features.
